items.optimize_reason: Dual-anchor percentage dislocation with 2-day backfill. Combines post-news arrival drift and end-of-day VWAP deviation into a single composite percentage dislocation. Normalized by news_eod_vwap to eliminate cross-sectional size/dollar distortion. Backfilled for 2 days to capture the prime mean-reversion window while reducing turnover below 70%.

Dual-anchor percentage dislocation with 3-day holding. Directly compares with Slot 1 to map the optimal decay horizon for dual-anchored overreaction. Expected turnover ~50%, scaling margin to > 3.0 bps and pushing Fitness above 0.85.

Open-to-close + post-news dual drift with 2-day backfill. Merges the explosive intraday news drift (close - ton_last) with the long-horizon institutional persistence of COPEN (close - open, 2Y=2.35). Normalizing by news_open ensures scale neutrality. 2-day backfill preserves the high Sharpe of both engines while curbing rebalancing friction.
Open-to-close + post-news dual drift with 3-day backfill. 3-day holding window for the COPEN + CTN confluence signal. Expected turnover ~45%, targeting Fitness >= 1.00 and zero cluster test warnings.

Gaussian quantile concentrated core on CTN with 2-day backfill. Rather than uniform ranking, gaussian quantiles concentrate portfolio weights on the high-conviction tails while shrinking the noisy middle to zero. This cuts turnover while boosting Sharpe.
Gaussian quantile weighting on the dual-anchor dislocation. Delivers optimal tail concentration and turnover compression for the highest expected Sharpe configuration.

Industry neutralized dual drift with 3-day backfill. Within-industry relative ranking on the dual-anchor dislocation. Isolates pure idiosyncratic micro-overreaction by removing industry-wide momentum, designed specifically to pass CLUSTER_TEST with zero warnings.

Linear decay smoothing on 3-day dual-anchor surface. Weights Day 1 at 3/6, Day 2 at 2/6, Day 3 at 1/6, eliminating abrupt step-function rebalancing and compressing turnover below 35% while expanding margin.
